main_metric: paired_correct on ALL_ATTACKS/ALL; endpoint-weighted, mean over fixed trained heads
denominators: Unconditional on nominal correctness; no conditional-detection denominator. ALL_ATTACKS pools endpoints. Classes are balanced in ALL but may not be balanced within CHANGED/UNCHANGED strata.
strata: ALL includes every pair. CHANGED and UNCHANGED partition ALL by exact full-L10 22-field differences. Benign nominal strata use any recorded baseline impairment flag in L10, as audit metadata only.

intervals.pairing: same multiplicity vector across all six class replicas, all models, and all four regimes
intervals.estimator: ratio of endpoint sums after episode resampling; fixed-head mean; not equal-weight episode-rate mean
intervals.intervals: linear percentile95, conditional on fixed source realization/encoder/heads; no equivalence tests
intervals.empty_strata: NA, not zero. Omit zero-denominator draws and report their count; CI suppressed if <2 contributing clusters
intervals.multiplicity: 32 TST-minus-comparator contrasts for ALL_ATTACKS/ALL paired_correct: four conditions x eight comparators. Provide unadjusted95 and Bonferroni95 across those32 only; all analyses retrospective/descriptive

limitations: Within-generator matched prediction response, not external validity, raw-vs-semantic superiority, absence of all simulator fingerprints, or isolated-factor causal identification.
identical_input_check: Pipeline consistency only; deterministic incorrect models can also pass.
